reason: PURE. The first thing I saw was 200 mg elemental, no oxide, and the QR lab report, which is exactly what I check on a label. The 3-form complex only has 60 mg of bisglycinate, so I would skip it and try the plain one box first.
objection: New brand, so I want to open that QR report and see a real lab name and numbers that match the box before I trust it. Also $29.99 for 30 days is more than I pay for bottles I already half-use.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report did not load or the batch result did not show the magnesium content, I would not buy.
